pandas.IntervalIndex.from_arrays

pandas 3.1.1 · Index objects · method

Build an object from parallel arrays. For a MultiIndex each array supplies a level. For interval data the arrays supply left and right edges.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

IntervalIndex.from_arrays(left, right, closed='right', name=None, copy=False, dtype=None)
